mechanism: NSAIDs like celecoxib may reduce the efficacy of levodopa by inhibiting prostaglandin-mediated dopaminergic neurotransmission and can increase risk of GI bleeding when combined with levodopa's effects on gastric mucosa.
action: Monitor for reduced antiparkinsonian effect and signs of GI bleeding; consider alternative analgesic if possible or use gastroprotection with PPI if combination is necessary.
